description: Sign up for a 30-day Free Trial and get access to this and 20+ ZoomCharts visuals.Looking for a bubble visual that can show a clear overview and give quick access to deeper insights, all within the same chart? With Drill Down Bubble PRO (Filter), you can create beautiful and user-friendly bubble charts that offer interactive drill downs, touch-friendly navigation, and an extensive list of customization features. MAIN FEATURES: ‘Marker Size’ Field: Use numeric values to automatically determine the size of each marker. You can also set minimum and maximum marker size limits in the settings. Multi-level Drill Down: Represent entire categories as data points. Users can simply click on a data point to reveal deeper insights on-demand. Class-leading Interactivity: Enjoy smooth and intuitive user experience. Pan the chart freely, zoom in and out, and easily select or drill down. Multiple Ways to Select: Select one or multiple data points by clicking or make bulk selections with rectangle and lasso selection tools. Thresholds: Compare your data against KPIs or benchmarks by enabling up to four static or dynamically calculated threshold lines or areas on each axis. Dynamic Regression Line: Display a regression line that is dynamically recalculated to instantly reflect any changes in the chart.
